_: 16h K14 yard truth table: hand-written from the mesh geometry (tooling/asset-pipeline/output/kits raw GLBs: bounds, up-facing bands, walkable deck) before the mined records were read. sinkM/waterlineM are [low, high] in metres, designedSinkM sign (positive = pivot below the ground or water line). anchorClass lists the classes that are right for the piece. kit null = a composite part no shipped kit carries as its own asset.

assets.assetId: htbm:here there be monsters - curse of cipactli/architecture/villages/kothringi/tamu_wooddock01
assets.why: Dock plank run on 1.4 m legs: pivot 0.07 m above the leg tips, deck top 1.51 m above the pivot (60% of the footprint at 1.4 m). A stilt fit is seated by its deck (owner 2026-09-23): deck 0.1-0.7 m above the support, legs buried, so sink = deck - clearance = 0.8-1.4 m.
Cave-mouth frame set into a bank: pivot at mid-height, floor band at -1.36 m (26% of the footprint), mesh bottom -1.83 m. The floor meets the ground, the 0.47 m skirt below it is buried.
Plank raft: 82% of the footprint is its deck at the pivot (z 0 to 0.1 m) over logs to -0.47 m. It floats with the deck just clear of the water: water 0.05 m above to 0.45 m below the pivot.

Vanilla farmhouse: the floor and the door sill sit at the pivot (door leaf bottom z 0.0), a 1.82 m stone foundation below it is meant to be buried on a slope. The door sill at or up to 0.6 m above the ground.
The composite's shell: same geometry and seating.
Door leaf with its bottom at its pivot, 2.5 m tall and 0.64 m thick: it hangs in the farmhouse doorway, never stands on the ground.
Keep wall, 13.06 m tall, base at the pivot, walkway at 10.9 m. Stands on its base; the makers set keep walls into the ground up to about 2 m.
Gate section of the same keep grid (x -3.641 to +3.641 m): base at the pivot.
Tower section of the same grid, 7.28 m wide, bulging to y -3.81 m: base at the pivot.
Ruined wall, broken end at +x (x max 3.278 m): base at the pivot.
Two vanilla dock decks on pilings reaching 6.23-6.30 m under the deck top at the pivot: they stand in deep water with the deck 0.3-2.0 m above it.
Dock deck at the pivot (66% of the footprint at z 0) on 6.23 m pilings: water-standing.
As dockstrent01.
The hut at scale 1.3 (mesh bottom -3.82 m) with its door leaf's sill at -3.84 m: the door threshold and the hut's base meet the ground, the pivot stands about 3.8 m above it.
The unit-scale hut shell: mesh bottom -2.94 m under the pivot is its base on the ground (placed at 1.3 by the composite).
Entrance ring stepping out of the hut wall; stands on the ground at the doorway or butts the wall.
Load door leaf: hangs in its frame.
Free-standing imperial wall 6.1 x 0.69 x 4.9 m: a plinth from -0.34 m to the pivot, the wall face above. The pivot at the floor or ground, the plinth buried or flush.
Sign post 2.74 m tall with its base at the pivot, arm at the top: set into the ground up to 0.6 m.
Sign board: 0.16 m above its pivot and 1.05 m below it, 0.25 m thick: it hangs from the post's arm.
Wall sconce: its back plate is flat at x = 0 (x max 0.012 m) and it reaches 0.2 m out: fixed to a wall face.
Stilt house: deck at -1.27 m (77% of the footprint) on legs to -8.47 m. Seated by the deck 0.15-2.5 m above the ground or water, legs buried.
The composite's shell: same geometry.
Door leaf 2.35 x 0.09 m, bottom at its pivot: hangs in the stilt house doorway.
Bosmer walkway stair: bottom tread band at the pivot (z 0-0.1 m), supports reaching 1.54 m below. The bottom tread at the support, the supports buried.

mountPairs.why: The sconce's flat back meets the free wall's 0.69 m-thick face; vanilla imperial dungeons hang these sconces on the clutter-kit walls.
The board hangs from the post's arm at 2.74 m (the post's only broad top band).

wallRun.why: Every keep section spans x -3.641 to +3.641 m on one 7.282 m grid, except the ruined ends (destroyed01 at -x 3.263, destroyed02 at +x 3.278): the run joins end to end at 7.282 m with the broken ends outward.
